sourceCopy.name: Rhyme Finder
sourceCopy.title: Rhyme Finder Free Online | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Group words by matching written endings in a poem or custom list. Free, private, and no account. Spelling helper, not a pronunciation dictionary.
sourceCopy.intro: Paste a poem, verse, or word list to group words that share a written ending. Choose how many final letters to compare and whether to ignore accents.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does this rhyme finder work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It groups words by matching their final written letters. It does not compare pronunciation, stress, or syllables, so a shared spelling ending is not a guarantee that words rhyme when spoken.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Text is analyzed in this browser and is not uploaded or saved.
howTo: Paste a poem, verse, or your own list of words.
Choose the number of final letters to match and whether to ignore accent marks.
Analyze the text to see repeated spelling endings; copy the groups if useful.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this check how words sound?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It compares written endings only and does not use a pronunciation dictionary or phonetic transcription.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use words from any language?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Unicode letters are supported, but results are based on spelling and may not match how words sound in that language.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I paste a whole poem?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. The local input is limited to 50,000 characters and 5,000 words.

fields.textHint: Paste your own text. Words are extracted in your browser.

fields.privacyNote: Runs locally; text is not uploaded or saved.
fields.limitNote: Limit: 50,000 characters and 5,000 words. Results compare spelling, not pronunciation.
